description: Without approve, only reads a video's check and approval state (is the post live on the creator's own account, when it counts as approved). approve: true approves it, which lets the creator be paid from money already collected. approve: false needs reason and sends the video back to the creator. Ask your person before deciding unless they told you not to. A checked video nobody answers within 48 hours counts as approved.

approve.description: true approves the video, false sends it back. Leave out to only read.

casting_id.description: The casting id that cast returned.

casting_token.description: The casting_token that cast returned when it was called without an API key. Not needed with an API key.

reason.description: Required with approve: false: what the creator should change.

name: check_video
title: See or decide on a video
